text:
nina: Heads-up — we just detected a cache invalidation cascade in us-east 1 hitting embeddings & rerank. Error rate up ~8% on canary.

sam: Copy. Which release is rolling? 3.2.2-canary right?

deploy-bot: Automation: rollout job 54678 => PAUSED by incident rule. Canary instances stopped. Version pinned to 3.2.1 for active traffic.

nina: Correct. Canary was 3.2.2. I'm pausing all downstream zones. @eli @tess please standby for rollback decision.

eli: Looking at logs now. There's a regression in KV cache eviction timing from the new kernel. Quick triage says a fix will take >2h.

tess: Ops: can we mitigate by reverting cache config or is full rollback safer?

ops-bot: Suggestion: toggle eviction-policy back to legacy in us-east via feature flag; requires coordinated restart of 4 pods. Estimated 15m.

sam: My preference is a config rollback first. If that fails, full deploy rollback. We need to move today's release window though.

nina: Agreed. Action plan: 1) ops applies legacy eviction flag in us-east (tess). 2) QA runs focused embedding smoke (eli). 3) if green, we resume canary; if fail, full rollback to 3.2.1. 4) reschedule global release to next change window.

tess: Applying flag now.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: apply-flag job started (job 98022). Notifying on completion.

eli: Smoke tests running — embedding latency back to baseline in first 10 mins. No errors so far.

nina: Nice. Can we resume a limited canary (10%) only in us-east and monitor 30m?

sam: Yes. Also draft release note update and call out cache eviction change. @product-slo can you sign off on delaying GA?

product-slo: Signed off on delay. Update release note: "Temporarily postponed GA. Fix applied to eviction config; full release will resume after extended canary and postmortem." Keep me looped.

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed at 10% (job 54678). Monitoring window: 30m. Will auto-pause on error spike >2%.

nina: Putting global rollout on hold until Monday 02:00 UTC change window. Bob (oncall) to own rollback path if we see regression overnight.

sam: I'll update the release calendar and close the PR for the GA note. Requeue final rollout for Mon 02:00 UTC.

tess: Ops escalation checklist run and recorded in incident tracker: incident/2026-03-cache-evict.

nina: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short in this thread. If anything changes, ping @here.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for summary. pause reason: incident-cache-evict-us-east. resumable after manual approval or automated canary green.
